description: Chashma Sugar Mills Limited is a Pakistani sugar producer of the Premier Group, set up by its sponsors in 1991 in Dera Ismail Khan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It operates two units there — a 12,000 tons-of-cane-per-day mill the company describes as the largest in Pakistan, and a second 6,000 TCD mill at Ramak — for a combined rated crushing capacity of 18,000 tons per day, and it has worked with growers to bring thousands of acres under cane. Beyond sugar it produces ethanol, bagasse and molasses.
